description: Read-only Solana risk checks for launches, linked holders, wallets, pools, Orca LP positions, perp venues and planned swaps, with verdicts, reasons and evidence. Analytical tools require a registered account and API key; only service_stats and score_performance are public without an account.

notes: Analytical tools require a registered account and API key as Authorization: Bearer <DEXRA_API_KEY> or X-Api-Key. Obtain a key at https://dexra.dev/app/keys. Only service_stats and score_performance are public; describe_address requires account authorization despite costing zero credits.
Registered-account x402 payments retain account authorization; anonymous payments do not grant analysis access. The local stdio bridge reads DEXRA_API_KEY.

clients: Any MCP client supporting Streamable HTTP
license: MIT for client bridge and configurations; hosted service.

notes: Profile claimed by @oblivisheee, owner of the dexra-dev GitHub organization and the @dexra-dev npm scope, in #4129.
